title: Portugal Seeks Better Offers for National Airline TAP Stake
summary: The Portuguese government has extended talks and requested improved offers from Air France-KLM and Lufthansa for the privatization of its national airline, TAP Air Portugal. The deal involves selling up to 49.9% of TAP's share capital, with an additional 5% reserved for employees. The government is seeking to finalize the sale soon.
summary_points: Portugal's government is seeking improved offers for TAP Air Portugal.
Air France-KLM and Lufthansa are the potential buyers.
The deal involves selling up to 49.9% of TAP's shares.
An additional 5% stake is reserved for TAP employees.
